data.name: Manikram
data.long_meaning: Manikram is derived from Sanskrit words 'Mani' meaning jewel and 'Krama' meaning power. It is the name of a king in Hindu mythology who is known for his wealth and power. The name is often given to children born on a Tuesday and is considered lucky for those in creative fields.
